```{r}
library(plm)
library(data.table)
library(panelvar)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
df <- fread(here("data", "processed", "sanctions_violence", "sanctions_violence_panel.csv"))
head(df)
```
```{r}
# assume df has columns: id, year, x
# decide on a reasonable minimum, e.g. 10 years
min_obs <- 20

keep_units <- na_check %>%
  filter(n_valid >= min_obs) %>%
  pull(gw_name)

df_filtered <- df %>% filter(gw_name %in% keep_units)

pdata_filtered <- pdata.frame(df_filtered, index = c("gw_name", "year"))
pdim(pdata_filtered)
```





```{r}


# Im-Pesaran-Shin — heterogeneous unit root process (most commonly used)
ips <- purtest(pdata_filtered$num_sanctioners, test = "ips", lags = "AIC", pmax = 8, exo = "intercept")
summary(ips)

# Maddala-Wu (Fisher-ADF) — combines individual p-values
mw <- purtest(pdata_filtered$num_sanctioners, test = "madwu", lags = "AIC", exo = "intercept")
summary(mw)

# Choi's Z-statistic — another Fisher-type combination
choi <- purtest(pdata_filtered$num_sanctioners, test = "invnormal", lags = "AIC", exo = "intercept")
summary(choi)


```

```{r}
zero_var_units <- df_filtered %>%
  group_by(gw_name) %>%
  summarise(
    var_sanctioners = var(num_sanctioners, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_obs = sum(!is.na(num_sanctioners))
  ) %>%
  filter(var_sanctioners < 1e-8 | is.na(var_sanctioners) | n_obs < 15) %>%
  pull(gw_name)


zero_var_units <- c(zero_var_units, "German Democratic Republic")

df_filtered3 <- df_filtered %>% filter(!(gw_name %in% zero_var_units))
pdata_filtered3 <- pdata.frame(df_filtered3, index = c("gw_name", "year"))
```


```{r}
ips <- purtest(pdata_filtered3$num_sanctioners, test = "ips", lags = "AIC", pmax = 2, exo = "intercept")
options(digits = 4)
options(max.print = 100000) 
summary(ips)


```


```{r}
# Maddala-Wu (Fisher-ADF) — combines individual p-values
mw <- purtest(pdata_filtered3$num_sanctioners, test = "madwu", lags = "AIC", pmax=2, exo = "intercept")
options(digits = 4)
summary(mw)
```



```{r}
plot_country <- function(name) {
  d <- df_filtered3[df_filtered3$gw_name == name, ]
  plot(d$year, d$num_sanctioners, type = "l",
       xlab = "Year", ylab = "Num. Sanctioners", main = name)
  points(d$year, d$num_sanctioners, pch = 16)
}

plot_country("Turkmenistan")
plot_country("Slovenia")
plot_country("Afghanistan")
plot_country("Argentina")
plot_country("Cambodia (Kampuchea)")
plot_country("Guatemala")
plot_country("Armenia")
```


```{r}

# Maddala-Wu (Fisher-ADF) — combines individual p-values
mw <- purtest(pdata_filtered3$mrgdppc, test = "madwu", lags = "AIC", pmax=2, exo = "intercept")
options(digits = 4)
summary(mw)
```



```{r}
# Maddala-Wu (Fisher-ADF) — combines individual p-values
mw <- purtest(pdata_filtered3$mrgdppc, test = "madwu", lags = "AIC", pmax=2, exo = "trend")
options(digits = 4)
summary(mw)
```
```{r}
#create a detrended gdp
df_filtered3 <- df_filtered3 %>%
  group_by(gw_name) %>%
  mutate(
    mrgdppc_detrended = if (sum(!is.na(mrgdppc)) >= 3) {
      residuals(lm(mrgdppc ~ year, na.action = na.exclude))
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```



```{r}
pdata_filtered3 <- pdata.frame(df_filtered3, index = c("gw_name", "year"))
mw_detrended <- purtest(pdata_filtered3$mrgdppc_detrended, test = "madwu", lags = "AIC", pmax = 2, exo = "intercept")
summary(mw_detrended)
```

```{r}
#check NAs

sum(is.na(pdata_filtered3$mrgdppc_detrended))
length(unique(pdata_filtered3$gw_name[!is.na(pdata_filtered3$mrgdppc_detrended)]))
length(unique(pdata_filtered3$gw_name))
```
